name: Obsolete Friends
storyline: Luna, a Moon Guardian bunny, has taken a break from their mission and moved to Moonlight Highs, where their everyday routine is helping out their neighbors. Luna is in need of your help too: help them bring kindness and hope in a world that has been consumed by darkness, get to know your strange but friendly neighbors and be the best friend you can be! Just try to not think about what's missing...
summary: Obsolete Friends is a story focused semi-horror RPG Maker game where you play as Luna, a Moon Guardian bunny, in their everyday routine of helping out their neighbors. Help them bring kindness and hope in a world that has been consumed by darkness, get to know your strange but friendly neighbors and be the best friend you can be! Just try to not think about what's missing...
